description: أغلقي يومكِ بلحظة انتعاش. غسول بانوكسيل الرغوي بتركيز 10% بنزويل بيروكسيد، عبوة 156 غرامًا، يختلف عن نسخة 4% الموجودة في المتجر. اختاريه وفق تعليمات العبوة وتوجيه المختص عند الحاجة، وامنحي البشرة ترطيبًا واهتمامًا منتظمًا.

en.name: PanOxyl · Acne Foaming Wash Benzoyl Peroxide 10%
en.tagline: A clearly labelled step for an acne-care routine.
en.description: PanOxyl · Acne Foaming Wash Benzoyl Peroxide 10% is a benzoyl peroxide acne wash. Check the strength on the exact pack and follow its Drug Facts directions; the 4% and 10% versions are different products.
benefits: Rinse-off format; follow your exact pack.
en.howToUse: Follow the Drug Facts directions on your exact pack. Rinse thoroughly; do not leave this wash on as a serum.
en.notes: Avoid eyes, lips and mouth. Benzoyl peroxide can cause dryness or irritation and bleach hair or fabrics. Do not use if sensitive to it. Ask a health professional before use in pregnancy or breastfeeding; stop and seek advice for severe irritation.
